before: The HTML clipboard flavor wrote every ordered list level as decimal unless its number format was a Latin letter or roman format. Paste read only those CSS counter styles back.
after: Copy writes each list number format that has a predefined CSS counter style of the same numeral system as that style, and paste maps the style back to the number format.
reason: The HTML flavor is written and read locally at the clipboard boundary. Paste still inserts the same fragment package through the existing rich paste operations, with only a different numFmt value in its numbering part. No shared field, operation, node identity, snapshot, or awareness payload changes.
